Class ToolkitRunner

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.app.ToolkitRunner
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ToolkitRunner extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Runner for DSL applications with automatic event routing.

Events are routed to elements based on focus and position. Elements handle their own events via handlers set with onKeyEvent() and onMouseEvent(). 

import static toolkit.dev.tamboui.Toolkit.*;

try (var runner = ToolkitRunner.create()) {
    int[] count = {0};  // State in lambda scope

    runner.run(() ->
        panel("Counter",
            text("Count: " + count[0]).bold().cyan()
        )
        .rounded()
        .id("counter")
        .focusable()
        .onKeyEvent(event -> {
            if (event.isUp()) {
                count[0]++;
                return EventResult.HANDLED;
            }
            return EventResult.UNHANDLED;
        })
    );
}

    • run

      public void run(Supplier<Element> elementSupplier) throws Exception
      Runs the application with the given element supplier. The supplier is called each frame to get the current UI state.

      Events are routed to elements based on their handlers. Press 'q' or Ctrl+C to quit (when no element consumes the event).

      If fault-tolerant rendering is enabled (via builder), individual element render failures are caught and replaced with error placeholders, allowing the rest of the UI to continue rendering.

      Parameters:
      elementSupplier - provides the root element for each render
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during execution

    • schedule

      public ToolkitRunner.ScheduledAction schedule(Runnable action, Duration delay)
      Schedules an action to run after a delay.

      The action runs on the scheduler thread. If the action modifies UI state, use runOnRenderThread(Runnable) to ensure thread safety: 

      runner.schedule(() -> {
    runner.runOnRenderThread(() -> {
        message = "Delayed message!";
    });
}, Duration.ofSeconds(2));
      Parameters:
      action - the action to run
      delay - the delay before running
      Returns:
      a handle that can be used to cancel the scheduled action

    • scheduleRepeating

      public ToolkitRunner.ScheduledAction scheduleRepeating(Runnable action, Duration interval)
      Schedules an action to run repeatedly at a fixed interval.

      The action runs on the scheduler thread. If the action modifies UI state, use runOnRenderThread(Runnable) to ensure thread safety. 

      var repeating = runner.scheduleRepeating(() -> {
    runner.runOnRenderThread(() -> counter++);
}, Duration.ofMillis(100));

// Later, to stop:
repeating.cancel();
      Parameters:
      action - the action to run
      interval - the interval between runs
      Returns:
      a handle that can be used to cancel the scheduled action

    • scheduleWithFixedDelay

      public ToolkitRunner.ScheduledAction scheduleWithFixedDelay(Runnable action, Duration delay)
      Schedules an action to run repeatedly with a fixed delay between runs.

      Unlike scheduleRepeating(Runnable, Duration), this waits for each execution to complete before scheduling the next one. This is useful when the action's duration is unpredictable and you want consistent spacing between runs.

      The action runs on the scheduler thread. If the action modifies UI state, use runOnRenderThread(Runnable) to ensure thread safety.

      Parameters:
      action - the action to run
      delay - the delay between the end of one run and the start of the next
      Returns:
      a handle that can be used to cancel the scheduled action

    • styledAreaRegistry

      public StyledAreaRegistry styledAreaRegistry()
      Returns the styled area registry for styled span lookups.

      The registry is populated during rendering when styled content with Tags is written to the buffer. It can be used by effect systems to target styled spans using CSS-like selectors.

      the styled area registry

    • builder

      public static ToolkitRunner.Builder builder()
      Creates a builder for configuring a ToolkitRunner.

      The builder provides a fluent API for configuring bindings, style engine, and automatic registration of action handlers. 

      try (var runner = ToolkitRunner.builder()
        .bindings(BindingSets.vim())
        .app(this)
        .withAutoBindingRegistration()
        .build()) {

    runner.run(() -> ...);
}
      Returns:
      a new builder
